name: paraphrase_hardening
description: Four paraphrase-axis fixes, each gated to lanes that only run when exact parsing already failed, so clean input is untouched by construction: (1) recover verbatim constraint strings from messages no template matched; (2) treat an unmatched turn-1 opening as unknown scenario and withhold seen-recording within the override-gate bound; (3) denormalize conversational phrasings onto the catalog's own metadata idioms; (4) match category buckets by word count, not word set, so set-identical sibling names cannot fall to an alphabetical tie-break.
